{"summary":"How to ease pelvic cramps and period pain?","whatText":"Aching or throbbing contractions in the lower abdomen or pelvic basin right before and during menstruation.","understandText":"The uterine lining produces prostaglandins, chemical messengers that induce uterine muscle contractions to shed the endometrium. Higher prostaglandin levels equal more intense cramps.","careText":"Apply a warm heating pad or hot water bottle to the lower abdomen (heat may provide comfort for some people). Sip warm ginger or chamomile tea, and practice gentle pelvic rocking.","watchText":"Keep track of how long cramps last. Typical primary dysmenorrhea peaks on days 1-2 and recedes significantly by day 3.","escalateText":"Seek medical advice if pain is so severe you vomit or miss work, radiates sharply down your legs, or starts worsening after age 25 (possible endometriosis or fibroids).","safetyLevel":"REVIEW","source":"Curated Clinical Knowledge","symptoms":"","flow":"","energy":"","mood":"","pain":0,"coins":0,"econ":"","pay":"","clarify":false,"clarifyMsg":"","choices":"","raw":"my cramps are severe today"}

{"summary":"Why am I so tired before my period?","whatText":"A noticeable decline in physical stamina and mental focus in the 3 to 7 days before menstruation.","understandText":"After ovulation, progesterone rises and then plummets alongside estrogen if conception didn't occur. This hormonal dive lowers brain serotonin and metabolic efficiency.","careText":"Consider magnesium-containing foods if they suit you, prioritize rest, and choose gentler movement if intense exercise feels difficult.","watchText":"Monitor whether fatigue lifts within 1-2 days of your period starting, and check for signs of daytime drowsiness impacting daily function.","escalateText":"Consult a physician if exhaustion is debilitating, doesn't improve after your period starts, or is accompanied by breathless episodes (possible anemia or thyroid imbalance).","safetyLevel":"REVIEW","source":"Curated Clinical Knowledge","symptoms":"","flow":"","energy":"","mood":"","pain":0,"coins":0,"econ":"","pay":"","clarify":false,"clarifyMsg":"","choices":"","raw":"why do I feel bloated before my period"}
